description: Alouette II number 238 in the museum's collection.
Half-scale reproduction of Armand Zipfel's 1908 aeroplane.
Amateur-built Pou-du-Ciel type in the collection.
Alpha Jet number 8 in Patrouille de France colours.
Ouragan number 297; its restoration won the Grand Prix de l'Aéro-Club de France in 2020 and it was displayed on the forecourt of the Invalides in Paris for three months in 2022.
Mirage III E 001. Tail left blank because the museum also holds Mirage IIIB 001 and the database keys aircraft on model plus tail.

Mirage III R prototype number 02, a unique airframe. Tail left blank because the short French number 02 is shared with the Mirage IIIA 02 displayed at ISAE-SUPAERO and the database keys aircraft on model plus tail.
Mirage IV P number 28; listed as a monument historique in April 2015.
Mirage 2000 C; serial not published by the museum.
Nord 1101 Ramier number 123. The museum's own list gives number 123 while the February 2025 ARDHAN naval inventory gives 125; the museum's figure is used here.
Jaguar E number 37, presented in a 30th-anniversary scheme noted for the quality of its presentation.
Concorde test fuselage section only, not a complete aircraft.
Fin only, displayed in the exhibition hall; not a complete airframe. Serial from the ARDHAN inventory of preserved French naval aircraft dated February 2025.
